translation.name: Habo nalolene bi gahenge lo winigo ogo

content: Anduane Homogo ibu dindi bibahendenaga kini kagonigo ogo

content.text: Dindi bibahendebi mbirale dindini karubi ngarubi
bibahendeore Anduane Homogo ibunaga hangu nga.
Wali agalibi mbirale tara tara dindini ema bialu piaga damenerubi
bibahendeore Anduane Homogo ibunaga hangu ka.
Anduane Homogohanda iba andaneha berelowa
dindi ogo daliga wabu ngeleda.
Dindi ogonaga gene dunini iba solowara timbuni bedago andaneha wa namu lowa
dindi ogo pagaho ngeleda.
Mbirali Anduane Homogo mitangi halu hari nene kagoria
iraga halu polene karulape ai kabe.
Anduane Homogonaga anda lomabia hene hari neneni kago
ge nahaga ogoniha ge yaanda halu polene karulape ai kabe.
Mbirali ibu gime mana ko mbira nabiagabi
ibu bu minime mana ko mbira mitangi nabiagabi
mbirale gime wabiniru mitangi nabiagabi
tindule ogoale buliya lowa lahondo nahagabi
uruniale nabiaga kago ibuni iraga halu polene karulape ka.
Wali agali urunibi karu
Anduane Homogohanda ti pele mialu mo bayale holebira.
Ngode Datagaliwabe ibugua tíha ko mbira nawi tí tigabiore kamigoni lolebira.
Wali agali urunibi karume
Ngode Datagaliwabe mitangi bialu ibu kagoria ibaga.
Yagabanaga Ngode Datagaliwabe kago mitangi bialu
ibuni kagoria kaware ibugu biaga.
Kini gibi kago ibu anda ibilo.
Panga payapai kamiruni amura dugu amu nana bidaba.
Panga haraba bambaore howa payaho wiaabo hene karuni dugupe hadaba.
Kini gibi biago ibilo ani bidaba.
Kini gibi ogoni ibu ai kabe.
Kini ogoni ibu Anduane Homogo hongo gibihe biago kagoni.
Anduane Homogo ogoni ibu wai bialu wayali haga gibi biagoni ka.

ibuniore Kini gibi ogoni kagoni.
